If false, check the unpayableReasons for details

lastChangeDateTimeUTC.description: The timestamp of the payee's latest change in UTC time zone, as per ISO 8601 standard.

currency.description: The payee's selected payment currency, as per ISO 4217 standard.

paymentMethodInformation.description: The information required to make payments via the payee's selected payment method.

paymentMethodType.description: The payee's selected payment method. See Payment methods for more information.

paymentTermId.description: The unique identifier of the payee's payment term.

preferredPayerEntityId.description:
The unique identifier of the payer entity assigned to the payee.
This ID is provided by the payer.

refCode.description:
The payee's unique reference code provided by the payer.
Across Tipalti system, refCode may be also referred to as IDAP or Payee ID.

status.description: The payee's current status. See Payee's status for more information.

statusChangeDateTimeUTC.description: The timestamp of the payee's latest status change in UTC time zone, as per ISO 8601 standard.

statusReason.description: The reason for the payee's status (blocked, suspended or closed). Tipalti can set the reasons automatically, or you can set them yourself.

unpayableReasons.description: The reasons why the payee can't be paid (isPayable property is set to false). View reasons.

description: Read payees, invoices, payments and accounting reference data; manage payees, tax codes and payment terms.

tipalti_new_custom_field_trigger.description: Runs for each new custom field in Tipalti. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

tipalti_new_gl_account_trigger.description: Runs for each new GL account in Tipalti. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

tipalti_new_invoice_trigger.description: Runs for each new invoice in Tipalti. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

tipalti_new_payee_trigger.description: Runs for each new payee in Tipalti. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

tipalti_new_payer_entity_trigger.description: Runs for each new payer entity in Tipalti. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

tipalti_new_payment_term_trigger.description: Runs for each new payment term in Tipalti. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

tipalti_new_payment_trigger.description: Runs for each new payment in Tipalti. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

tipalti_new_tax_code_trigger.description: Runs for each new tax code in Tipalti. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.
